limitations: Source-derived candidate; no local efficacy validation.
Original typed source inventory is not normalized; retain source identities and limits in the procedure/readsets.

applicability.scope: Diagnose attention-kernel bottlenecks after IO reduction, tile/pipeline regressions and precision or hardware-port assumptions.
applicability.input_contract: Actual kernel/device revisions, attention shapes and semantics, operand/accumulator types, correctness/quality criteria, and existing traffic, resource, parallelism and stall observations.
applicability.produced_artifact: A bottleneck diagnosis with confidence, one bounded candidate, resource exchange, counter-signal, missing evidence, source ID and next authorization gate.
applicability.refusal_point: Return conditional hypotheses when observations are missing; reject or defer changes with wrong outputs/gradients, unsafe lifetimes/order, unsupported primitives, unacceptable accuracy or gains erased by omitted work.

recommendations: Preserve masks, dropout replay, online-softmax normalization and gradient obligations before comparing costs; exact algebra does not imply bitwise equality.
After fusion, reclassify the exposed limit using scalar work, independent output tiles and resource ceilings; larger tiles and deeper pipelines can reduce residency or spill.
Include precision preprocessing/conversion in the measurement boundary and check generated asynchronous scheduling; validate accelerator-specific primitives separately before a port.
